posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md: colin, have you been able to fire up your 315 ? mine arrived today and i pulled it from box and now i realised i need to supply it with 24 DC volts ,is this how yours arrived? if so where did you get the dc power supply from?

posts.author: Tommy
posts.content_md:
> **dave battin:** colin, have you been able to fire up your 315 ? mine arrived today and i pulled it from box and now i realised i need to supply it with 24 DC volts ,is this how yours arrived? if so where did you get the dc power supply from?

I've been feeding mine about 15V. (unregulated linear power supply.)

According to the laser faq, it'll take 12 to 24, with the recomended voltage being on the order of 15.

The pins from PC disk power connectors fit the pins on the power supply's connector.

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md: I am using a 13.8 volt 300 watt switching power supply I had lying around. I have a 150 watt switching power supply at work that I will switch to soon.
